name: coding-agent
description: A local and GitHub-directed LLM development agent MVP.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @coding-agent/shared && npm run build --workspace @coding-agent/agent-core
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n daemon,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:daemon" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
